text: This report will update the Board of Management on the primary activities and achievements for the Strategic Communications Branch at the Toronto Zoo for the year 2021. The Strategic Communications team oversees the public facing communications outlets to connect our audiences to our animals, messages, events and activities.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (January 31, 2022) from the Senior Director, Strategic Communications and Guest Experience, Toronto Zoo for information.
